headword: {総額表示|そうがくひょうじ}
gloss: tax-inclusive price display; displaying the total price

definitions.gloss: tax-inclusive price display; showing the final all-inclusive total on price tags and advertisements
definitions.explanation: The practice of displaying the full, tax-included price on price tags, menus, and advertisements — rather than the pre-tax price. Under Japan's Consumer Tax Act, businesses selling to consumers are required to use {総額表示|そうがくひょうじ} so that the shopper can see at a glance what they will actually pay.

examples.japanese: {総額表示|そうがくひょうじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧だ。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦お{店|みせ}→お店：21164_omise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{総額表示|そうがくひょうじ}になっている。
examples.english: This shop uses tax-inclusive price displays.

examples.japanese: {2021年|にせんにじゅういちねん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{総額表示|そうがくひょうじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{完全義務化|かんぜんぎむか}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Tax-inclusive pricing became fully mandatory in 2021.

examples.japanese: {総額表示|そうがくひょうじ}なら、⟦レジ→レジ：00879_reji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{実際|じっさい}→実際：02502_jissai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧⟦{金額|きんがく}→金額：02665_kingaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一目|ひとめ}→一目：08728_hitome⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧わかる。
examples.english: With tax-inclusive pricing, you can tell at a glance how much you'll actually pay at the register.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{総額|そうがく}→総額：05472_sougaku⟧ (total amount) and ⟦{表示|ひょうじ}→表示：03143_hyouji⟧ (display, indication).

USAGE:
This is a retail and consumer-law term that most shoppers in Japan have seen on posters and receipts. The contrast is with ⟦{税抜|ぜいぬき}→税抜：09560_zeinuki⟧ pricing, where only the pre-tax amount is shown and consumption tax is added at checkout. Under the revised Consumer Tax Act, retailers selling to end consumers must show the tax-inclusive total — though they may also show the pre-tax price alongside.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {総額表示|そうがくひょうじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧: tax-inclusive pricing is mandatory
- {総額表示|そうがくひょうじ}⟦{義務化|ぎむか}→義務化：28603_gimuka⟧: making tax-inclusive pricing mandatory
- {総額表示|そうがくひょうじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to switch over to tax-inclusive pricing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{税込|ぜいこみ}→税込：09559_zeikomi⟧: tax included — the short tag placed on prices to indicate they already include tax
- ⟦{税抜|ぜいぬき}→税抜：09560_zeinuki⟧: tax excluded — the opposite; a label or pricing style showing the pre-tax amount only
- {本体価格|ほんたいかかく}: base price — the pre-tax price of an item, often shown in smaller print next to the total
